d: Why does Mayawati keep testing Akash Anand? In a recent rally in Bulandshahr, BSP leader Akash Anand revealed an emotional conversation with his aunt and Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) chief Mayawati. He recalled asking her why she repeatedly put him through tests. Mayawati's response reportedly reminded him of the lifelong struggles of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar and BSP founder Kanshi Ram, leaving him emotional.
